definitions.explanation: A dramatic reversal of fortune, especially a comeback victory in sports, an unexpected turnaround in business, or a surprising change of outcome. The word {劇|げき} (drama) emphasizes the dramatic or theatrical nature of the reversal.

examples.japanese: {見事|みごと}な{逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}だった。
{後半|こうはん}に{逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}が{起|お}きた。
examples.english: A dramatic comeback occurred in the second half.

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}もが{負|ま}けると{思|おも}っていた{試合|しあい}で、{歴史|れきし}に{残|のこ}る{逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}が{生|う}まれた。
examples.english: In a match everyone thought they would lose, a historic comeback was born.

notes:
Compound noun: {逆転|ぎゃくてん} (reversal) + {劇|げき} (drama, play). Frequently used in sports journalism and can also be applied to business or political turnarounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}を{演|えん}じる (to stage a dramatic comeback)
- {逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}が{起|お}きる (a turnaround occurs)
- {劇的|げきてき}な{逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき} (a dramatic comeback)
